### Observed differences

- In the later window, transitions out of A32 are redistributed: the share going to A37 rises from about 21 in 100 to about 35 in 100, while A36, A39 and A38 each lose a few points (A36 about 29→22, A39 about 29→22, A38 about 22→19 in 100). [DIR001]
- In the later window, A36 passes directly to A33 in about 59 in 100 of its outgoing transitions, up from about 40 in 100, while its transitions to A37 fall from about 58 to about 38 in 100. [DIR002]
- In the later window, A37 passes to A36 in about 60 in 100 of its outgoing transitions, up from about 42 in 100, while its transitions to A33 fall from about 58 to about 37 in 100. [DIR003]
- The positional gaps shift in the same direction: in the later window A36 follows A32 two steps later in about 59 in 100 of observed pairs (previously about 42, with one-step followings falling from about 58 to about 39 in 100). [LAG001]
- Likewise, A33 follows A36 one step later in about 60 in 100 of observed pairs in the later window (previously about 41, with two-step followings falling from about 59 to about 38 in 100). [LAG002]
- Taken together, the later window more often shows the sequence A32 → A37 → A36 → A33, where the earlier window more often showed A32 → A36 → A37 → A33; every one of these differences is larger than about 199 of 200 random re-splits of the pooled data, and each rests on roughly 100–200 observations per window. [DIR001, DIR002, DIR003, LAG001, LAG002]
- A few transitions appear only in the later window at very low shares (about 1 in 120–200 each, e.g. from A32 to A17, A10 or A33, from A36 to A08 or A24, from A37 to A08), which is typical of rare variants in a finite sample. [DIR001, DIR002, DIR003]

### Inference

Support level: Insufficient evidence

The evidence is insufficient to infer a structural change in the process. All five items describe the same connected cluster of activities (A32, A36, A37, A33) and therefore count as a single underlying difference, which is not clearly above the roughly 0.5 items expected by chance among the 99 tested units; a sampling shift in the mix of two co-existing route orders between the windows could produce the same coherent pattern [DIR001, DIR002, DIR003, LAG001, LAG002].
